tasks.title: tools/physics-test.mjs — the seven solver assertions
tasks.note: Seven gates. Reviewed: pyramid scene had 4-wide planks at 3-unit spacing so adjacent planks overlapped by a unit; the 0.75 threshold was hiding it. Fixed geometry, tightened to 0.05, added assertNoOverlap to every hand-placed scene and maxPenetration() to physics.js.

tasks.title: P1 gate — check + determinism green against the full solver, commit
tasks.note: Four engines bit-identical with the full solver. Determinism risk closed.

tasks.title: Author the sim params DESIGN.md left underspecified
tasks.note: Found while writing data.js. Blocks P3, not P1. Hulk radius vs '3x volume' disagree: 0.40->0.86 is neither 3x area (0.69) nor 3x radius. Chip's 22deg spread: total or per-fragment, and does each fragment keep parent speed or parent momentum. Pebble payload has no mass, size, release velocity or recoil. Gale's 2.5 has no unit. Kingslayer 'weakly' has no steering number. Airlift king drift has no range or period. Flak Hog does not say WHICH pig, and it must be deterministic - suggest a builder toggle in the editor. Mason does not say which destroyed block returns. Decoy King has no cost or stats. Second Slingshot has no second height.

tasks.title: Author per-level campaign star thresholds
tasks.note: SCORE.campaign has the formula but no thresholds; they arrive with the levels.

openRisks: RESOLVED 2026-08-22: cross-engine float determinism holds with the FULL solver. V8, SpiderMonkey and JavaScriptCore produce bit-identical digests over 1800 steps with SAT, manifolds, warm starting, impulses, position solve and sleeping all active. The relay audit model in ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 is viable and the lenient fallback is not needed. Re-run with `npm run test:determinism:all` after any change to physics.js or sim.js (podman; WebKit cannot launch on this host directly).
The airlift + gale + bedrock card combination may be a defensive lock. Intended fix is mutual exclusion in the draw, not a nerf.
52 authored campaign levels is the largest single time cost in the plan and depends on the editor being pleasant to use, which is why P4 precedes P5.
Simultaneous siege means the loser watches their own fortress fall in a 260x150 window. If that reads as noise rather than tension the mode's core hook fails, and it cannot be evaluated before P6.
